bitsmith_create.jei.line: The bit line, on a Create belt or a depot: the Bit Slicer cuts a block into 16 slices, the Bit Cutter a slice into 16 rods, the Bit Crusher a rod into 16 bits. 4096 bits per block. Place each machine two blocks above the belt, with one block of air between them, and turn it with a shaft: it works as fast as the shaft turns (2 seconds per cut at 16 rpm), stopped it lets items pass.
bitsmith_create.ponder.tag.bit_line.desc: Machines that cut whole blocks into bits
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_line.header: Cutting blocks into bits on a belt
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_line.text_1: The three machines go two blocks above a belt or a depot, with one block of air between them
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_line.text_2: A shaft through their sides turns them: the faster it turns, the faster they cut
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_line.text_3: The Bit Slicer cuts a block into 16 slices
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_line.text_4: The Bit Cutter cuts each slice into 16 rods
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_line.text_5: The Bit Crusher crushes each rod into 16 bits
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_line.text_6: 4096 bits come out of every block. Each machine only takes its own input, so one belt carries the whole line
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_depot.header: Using a bit line machine on a depot
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_depot.text_1: Each machine also works on a depot two blocks below it
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_depot.text_2: The pieces stay on the depot, ready for the next machine or a funnel
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_depot.text_3: Twice the speed, twice as fast: 2 seconds per cut at 16 rpm
bitsmith_create.ponder.bit_depot.text_4: Stopped, a machine leaves items alone and lets them pass along a belt
